description: 10-day-old newborn with high fever and lethargy
query: My 10-day-old baby has a fever of 38.5°C and seems extremely lethargic and pale.
notes: NICE CG160 / ESI Level 2: Neonatal fever <28 days is a medical emergency requiring septic workup.

description: 3-week-old neonate with cyanosis and respiratory distress
query: My 21-day-old infant has blue lips and is struggling to breathe with chest wall indrawing.
notes: ESI Level 1/2: Airway/breathing compromise with cyanosis.

description: 2-week-old newborn with bulging fontanelle
query: Notice my 14-day-old baby's soft spot on the top of the head is bulging and firm.
notes: Red flag sign for meningitis or raised ICP in neonates.

description: 20-day-old infant with poor feeding and hypothermia
query: My 20-day-old newborn refuses to feed since this morning and body temp is low at 35.8°C.
notes: Hypothermia in neonate is a hallmark sign of neonatal sepsis.

description: 4-week-old newborn with mild umbilical redness without fever
query: My 25-day-old baby has a small amount of dried blood/discharge around umbilical stump, no fever, active.
notes: Umbilical stump evaluation needed to rule out spreading omphalitis.

description: 6-week-old young infant with fever of 38.2°C
query: My 45-day-old infant has a fever measuring 38.2°C, fussy but drinking milk.
notes: NICE CG160: Fever in infants <90 days is high risk requiring urgent medical assessment.

description: 2-month-old infant with projectile vomiting after every feed
query: My 8-week-old baby vomits forcefully across the room after every feeding and seems hungry right after.
notes: Classic presentation of hypertrophic pyloric stenosis requiring urgent pediatric evaluation.

description: 50-day-old young infant with persistent cough and paroxysms
query: My 7-week-old baby has severe coughing fits followed by a whooping sound and turning red.
notes: Suspected pertussis (whooping cough) in young infant requiring evaluation and swab.

description: 2.5-month-old young infant with mild nasal congestion and no fever
query: My 75-day-old baby has a clear runny nose and mild stuffiness, sleeping well and feeding normally.
notes: Simple viral upper respiratory tract infection symptoms suitable for supportive home monitoring.

description: 2-month-old infant after routine immunizations with low-grade fever
query: Baby got 2-month vaccines 6 hours ago, has mild fever 37.8°C and slight fussiness.
notes: Expected mild post-vaccination reaction.

description: 6-month-old infant with fever, wheezing, and intercostal retractions
query: My 6-month-old has a 38.8°C fever, rapid breathing with ribs sticking out, and whistling chest sound.
notes: Moderate-to-severe bronchiolitis / respiratory distress requiring immediate clinical care.

description: 9-month-old infant with acute diarrhea and moderate dehydration signs
query: My 9-month-old has 8 watery diarrhea stools today, dry mouth, no wet diaper for 7 hours.
notes: Gastroenteritis with clinical signs of moderate dehydration.

description: 7-month-old infant with acute otitis media symptoms
query: My 7-month-old infant pulls at her right ear constantly, crying, and fever of 38.3°C.
notes: Acute otitis media (middle ear infection) symptom presentation.

description: 10-month-old infant with non-blanching petechial rash
query: My 10-month-old has small purple spots on skin that don't turn white when I press a glass against them.
notes: Non-blanching petechial rash is a high-risk red flag for meningococcal disease.

description: 11-month-old infant with mild diaper rash
query: My 11-month-old has red irritated skin in the diaper area, no fever, happy and playing.
notes: Irritant diaper dermatitis managed with barrier creams and frequent diaper changes.

description: 2-year-old toddler with barking cough and stridor at rest
query: My 2-year-old woke up with a harsh seal-like barking cough and squeaky noise when breathing in.
notes: Croup with inspiratory stridor requiring medical assessment.

description: 18-month-old toddler with febrile seizure history (first episode)
query: My 18-month-old had a 1-minute shaking episode during sudden fever jump, now awake but groggy.
notes: First febrile seizure warrants emergency evaluation to exclude intracranial infection.

description: 2.5-year-old toddler with hand-foot-mouth disease blisters
query: My 30-month-old has small red spots on palms, soles, and painful mouth sores, low fever 37.9°C.
notes: Hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) management and hydration guidance.

description: 3-year-old toddler with mild constipation for 2 days
query: My 3-year-old toddler hasn't passed stool in 2 days and complains of mild belly discomfort when trying.
notes: Functional childhood constipation suitable for dietary adjustment and routine care.

description: 2-year-old toddler swallowed small coin, no choking symptoms
query: My 2-year-old swallowed a small penny 20 minutes ago. He is breathing fine, no choking, smiling.
notes: Foreign body ingestion needs clinical evaluation and possible X-ray.

description: 4-year-old preschooler with suspected streptococcal pharyngitis
query: My 4-year-old has severe sore throat, fever 38.7°C, swollen neck glands, and no cough.
notes: Suspected Group A Strep pharyngitis needing rapid throat swab and evaluation.

description: 4.5-year-old preschooler with acute asthma exacerbation
query: My 4-year-old diagnosed with asthma is wheezing heavily, breathing 45 times a minute, albuterol not helping.
notes: Acute asthma exacerbation unresponsive to home rescue inhaler.

description: 3.5-year-old preschooler with localized impetigo crusts
query: My 42-month-old child has honey-colored crusted sores under her nose for 2 days.
notes: Impetigo presentation requiring outpatient antibiotic ointment prescription.

description: 4-year-old preschooler with mild head bump, active and alert
query: Child bumped forehead on coffee table 1 hour ago. Cried for 2 mins, no vomiting, no loss of consciousness, playing normally.
notes: Minor head trauma with low risk PECARN criteria suitable for home observation.

description: 5-year-old preschooler with acute right lower quadrant abdominal pain
query: My 5-year-old has severe sharp pain in the lower right belly, walking bent over, vomited twice.
notes: High suspicion for acute appendicitis requiring immediate emergency evaluation.
